port.name: Zed
port.description: Living Code for Zed. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
In Zed, open the Extensions panel (`zed: extensions`, or `cmd-shift-x` on macOS and `ctrl-shift-x` on Linux), search for **Living Code**, and click **Install**. Then pick a flavor with `theme selector: toggle` (`cmd-k cmd-t`).

Without the registry: run `zed: install dev extension` and select the repository root of a checkout, or download the theme file into `~/.config/zed/themes/`:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.config/zed/themes
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/zed/main/themes/living-code.json -o ~/.config/zed/themes/living-code.json
```

The theme file holds all four flavors.
guide.configuration: See [Zed's documentation](https://zed.dev) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies theme files for Zed, not the application itself. Install the application separately and follow the installation instructions for its supported configuration format.
